summary: Learn to structure, cost, and govern agricultural finance facilities through practical African agribusiness cases. Explore the course and enrol.
lede: Agricultural value-chain finance links funding to the transactions and cash flows connecting production, aggregation, storage and trade. For agricultural finance managers, lenders and development-finance practitioners, the training addresses how to assess and govern facilities tied to these activities. Exercises cover seasonal cash-flow and counterparty analysis, warehouse-receipt collateral controls, purchase-order finance assessment and portfolio monitoring, alongside crop-insurance interfaces and IFRS 9 expected credit loss considerations.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who structure, approve, administer, or oversee finance linked to agricultural production and trade.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working familiarity with agricultural lending, agribusiness operations, credit assessment, or development-finance programmes is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Bring a laptop with Excel access for spreadsheet exercises; advanced insurance design and legal structuring are covered at operational review level, not implementation level.
